description: GET /v1/webhooks/:id/deliveries - paginated delivery history for a webhook endpoint in the selected network mode. Specify mode when both or neither key modes are cached. Uses the cached sk_* key of that mode, else a fresh JWT (GET /v1/merchants/me/webhooks/:id/deliveries).

status.description: "exhausted" selects deliveries whose automatic retries ran out.

name: webhooks_deliveries
title: List webhook deliveries
